book.name: 1 Utasorhonika
book.title: Ubvur Uburhu uwu inggbaashia aka atsɛnge abi Utasorhonika

content: Umbi angwɛ̃mɛn nu anapumɛn, ri itsi ivang nu inum, umɛn isi ibeemɛn itsɛnga umbi,
ubinkutsu umbi ahwɛngmbi uku ushashaki ugɛ unum ukpu Uteijee uwuri iba ru nyaku uvɛu ru untsuuka.

Ivangyɛ anera aka ani igɔr agɛ, <<Umɛn isei isei uku ughwɔɔw nu ififɔrh,>> kanying itsitsim iwuri ikpo umbɔ, ru nyaki ihwashi imar iki ikpo ukutsɛrh uwuku uwu ra anaa, utsĩndĩ ishishɔɔr ushimgbɔ ru umbɔ.
Bɔr umbi angwɛ̃mɛn nu anapumɛn, umbi asi iwembi ru uzĩ, ngge itsú unum hã usi ígbipukpɔ umbi ru nyaku uvɛu.
Umbi kishoo awe angwɛ̃ irhirhang na angwɛ̃ atenum. Umɛn isi iwemɛn abi utsuu use abi uzĩ.
Nggee, umɛn niba iwemɛn ru nyaka abɔɔ aka awe ru urhɔ, bɔr umɛn isei ĩdzɛu ni ikpɔm atsimɛn.
Ubinkutsu abika arharhɔ arha ru untsuu nu abika afĩrhã adɛ afĩrhã ru untsuu.
Bɔr umɛn iki iwe abi atenum, awu ufang umɛn ingwɛ̃dzɛn ni ikpɔm atsimɛn, itsim imangmang nu ibibema ru nyaka atorho uzɔu aki ikɔk, ni ifosi ififɔrh ru nyaki ifur uzɔu.
Ubinkutsu, Unum asi itsũã umɛn ihwa ayetnum avɔmnga, bɔr atsũ umɛn ikpo ififɔrh ru ubok Uteijeemɛn Uyesu Ukiristo.
Unga akpe ri itsimɛn, ngge itsú uko umɛn iwu aka arhi use umɛn iwu ru urhɔ, umɛn ima isei urhɔnga nggu unga.
Nggee àka afita adɔka na adzin adɔka, ru nyaka umbi aki ikorhe.
Imimashi imesa
Umbi angwɛ̃mɛn nu anapumɛn, umɛn ishɔ̃rhã umbi, àka adzowe imor ra abika atɛ̃wũ itser ru umbi, anggbaashimbi ru Uteijee, abika adzaa umbi itsũwã.
Àka akpɔm umbɔ afafã ri ibibema ri itsi itsermbɔ. Àka asei uku ughwɔɔw nggu adɔka.
Umbi angwɛ̃mɛn nu anapumɛn, umɛn ishɔ̃rhã umbi, àka agbiite ato abi ighɛrha ru umbi, àka afituwe abika asheri ikeramɛn ru umbi, àka ayike abika asheri iker ru umbi, àka adɔng amɛnmbi nggu ubɛn unera.
Àka angwɛ̃dzɛn, utsur unera afasa iyiki ibewe nggu iyiki ibewe, bɔr ubɛn ivang àka akorhi iyiki ize nggu adɔka nu ubɛn unera.
Àka agɔm anggɔm ubɛn ivang,
àka niba anekukumbi ifɛn-Num,
àka atar uwɛɛ ri kishoo ubinkpi uku uwe, ubinkutsu ngge iwu ibibemu Unum ru umbi ru Ukiristo Uyesu.
Àka niba arhĩwukumbi Ipfu-Num.
Àka niba akwɛɛrkumbi itser iyiki isɔm Arherhu-Num,
àka avira abina kishoo, na akpɔm akirakɛ aka awe aka aze,
àka atĩmbi ubɛn iyiki ibewe.
Unum nibikanga, Unum uwu ididɔɔr, ama asare umbi undzumunga, ipfumbi nu urhɛmbi nu ayormbi kishoo ima isheru uvau ru unumkpi Uteijeemɛn Uyesu Ukiristo aka iba.
Unga awuri ikorhunga ake, ubinkutsu unga uwuku uyisa umbi awu uner idzidzɛrhe.
Umbi angwɛ̃mɛn nu anapumɛn àka afɛna-Num ru umɛn.
Àka aghwe adɔka nggu ighwe ibibema.
Umum ishɔ̃rhã umbi ri itsok Uteijee, àka avarhuwe ubvur uwurɛ ra angwɛ̃mɛn nu anapumɛn kishoo.
Imimuta Uteijeemɛn Uyesu Ukiristo ima iwe nggu umbi.
